findings.requirement: Permitted catalog membership remains visible without operator credentials or a ready adapter.
findings.observed: Models uses RoutableSnapshot.Definitions, which iterates routable routes. The existing generation-retention test expects an empty model list after adapter removal.
findings.evidence: Two existing discovery tests pass under race detection. These tests confirm current behavior; they do not prove the revised discovery requirement.
findings.next_action: Add a regression for permitted discovery with no ready adapter and after adapter removal. Separate discovery membership from routing readiness while preserving current permission checks.

acceptance_inventory.interpretation: Missing registration is missing evidence, not proof of a runtime defect.
